title: Double and Iterated Integrals over Rectangles
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

definitions.title: Double Integral over a Rectangle
definitions.latex: \iint_R f(x, y) \, dA = \lim_{||P|| \to 0} \sum_{k=1}^n f(x_k^*, y_k^*) \Delta A_k
definitions.statement: The double integral of a continuous function f over a closed rectangle R = [a, b] x [c, d] is the limit of Riemann sums as the norm of the partition approaches zero. If f(x, y) >= 0, it represents the volume of the solid under the surface z = f(x, y) over R.
conditions: f is bounded and continuous almost everywhere on R
definitions.explanation: Subdivides R into small rectangular subregions of area Delta A = Delta x Delta y and sums column volumes.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Computes signed volumes and accumulated quantities across two-dimensional planar regions.

definitions.title: Fubini's Theorem (First Form)
definitions.latex: \iint_R f(x, y) \, dA = \int_a^b \int_c^d f(x, y) \, dy \, dx = \int_c^d \int_a^b f(x, y) \, dx \, dy
definitions.statement: If f(x, y) is continuous on the rectangle R = [a, b] x [c, d], then the double integral equals the iterated integral in either order of integration.
definitions.explanation: Reduces a two-dimensional double integral to two successive single-variable definite integrals.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Order of integration may be freely interchanged for continuous functions over rectangles.
